title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

title: ServiceNow Developer with Strategic Portfolio Management(SPM) & ITSM
description:
Title: ServiceNow Developer with Strategic Portfolio Management(SPM) & ITSM

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract

Job Specific Responsibilities:

● Have the ability to assist requesters in refining business requirement details to ensure the customers will be receiving functionality requested.

● Gain knowledge of our overall ServiceNow implementation to understand and identify cross platform impacts of changes or enhancements being requested.

● Design, develop, and implement SPM solutions including workflows, catalog items, workspaces, and integrations to meet complex business requirements

● Configure and customize the ServiceNow platform using javascript and ServiceNow APIs to extend capabilities and enhance user experience

● Design and implement workflows to support business needs and increase automation

● Develop and configure integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems using integration spokes or custom APIs

● Work within the Agile methodology to develop, build and test alongside other developers to ensure the best product is delivered to requestors in a timely manner

● Work with implementation partners, or internal project teams to Implement new modules as business needs evolve

● Assist with regular ServiceNow version upgrades to ensure we remain compliant and supported by the vendor

Key Skills, Requirements and Competencies:

● Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or a relevant technical field

● At least 3+ years experience working with the ServiceNow platform, specifically in the SPM module, and with good familiarity with ITSM, and the general ServiceNow platform

● Strong understanding of ITIL principles and practices

● Proficiency in JavaScript and ServiceNow API web services

● Proven experience with integrating ServiceNow with other applications

● Excellent analytical and problem solving skills

● Effective communication and interpersonal skills

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Javascript/React Software Developer – Contractor
description:
Position: Javascript/React Software Developer – Contractor

Location: Remote – Brazil

Contract Type: Service Contract (PJ/Freelancer)

Role Overview:

We are seeking a Software Developer with strong expertise in Javascript and React and proven web programming experience. The ideal candidate is also comfortable working with other programming languages, has advanced coding skills, and in-depth knowledge of modern HTML/CSS.

Responsibilities:

  • Write well-structured, testable, and efficient code following best development practices.
  • Create website layouts and user interfaces using modern HTML/CSS standards.
  • Integrate data from multiple back-end services and databases.
  • Develop back-end services using Node.js.
  • Work with other programming languages as required.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends, applying them to projects.
  • Collaborate with designers to ensure visual design alignment.
  • Preferred: experience with mobile development (iOS/Android) or React Native.

Requirements & Skills:

  • Solid experience in Javascript, React, and Node.js.
  • Strong programming skills and in-depth knowledge of modern HTML/CSS.
  • Understanding of web application functionality, including security and best practices.
  • Proven track record in web programming.
  • Knowledge of relational databases, object-oriented programming, and web application development.
  • Problem-solving and creative diagnosis skills.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).

Nice-to-Haves / Differentials:

  • Experience with Web3, MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js).
  • Mobile app development and integration with hardware SDKs, drones, or sensors.
  • Experience with prototyping, algorithms, R&D, QA, and software quality assurance.

Contract Details:

  • Contractor will work under a service agreement (PJ/Freelancer).
  • Contractor will issue monthly invoices for services rendered.
  • No employment relationship (CLT), and no employment benefits (transportation, vacation, 13th salary, etc.) are provided.
  • Flexible hours and autonomy in executing tasks, while meeting project deadlines and deliverables.

Keywords: Javascript, React, Node.js, MERN Stack, MongoDB, Express, Front-end, Back-end, Mobile (iOS/Android), React Native, Web Development, Software Development, R&D, Prototyping, QA, Algorithms, Engineering, Technology.

Location: Remote – Brazil

Contract Type: Service Contract (PJ/Freelancer)

We are seeking a Software Developer with strong expertise in Javascript and React and proven web programming experience. The ideal candidate is also comfortable working with other programming languages, has advanced coding skills, and in-depth knowledge of modern HTML/CSS.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Busca & Recomendação
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um Staff Software Engineer para atuar como referência técnica no time de busca e recomendação , contexto esse de alta criticidade. Sendo responsável por construir e evoluir soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alto desempenho .

Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução arquitetural , na tomada de decisões tecnológicas , na elevação contínua da qualidade técnica e na condução de iniciativas de alto impacto para o negócio .


O que você vai fazer

  • Atuar como referência técnica do time , guiando decisões arquiteturais e garantindo excelência em engenharia;
  • Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir sistemas de larga escala utilizando Go (Golang) e .NET;
  • Arquitetar e implementar soluções em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , com foco em automação, escalabilidade, segurança e confiabilidade;
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais , garantindo performance e consistência;
  • Implementar e evoluir práticas de observabilidade , utilizando Datadog, Grafana e ferramentas correlatas;
  • Liderar iniciativas de CI/CD , qualidade de código e engenharia de confiabilidade (SRE);
  • Mentorar engenheiros, promovendo boas práticas, padrões técnicos e crescimento do time .


O que você precisa para a posição no jogo:

  • Experiência com ElasticSearch , incluindo tuning e otimização de motores de busca para e-commerce;
  • Conhecimento em Machine Learning aplicado a relevância e ranking , do motor de busca;
  • Domínio em .NET e/ou Golang;
  • Forte experiência com GCP e infraestrutura em cloud;
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de produtores e consumidores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka);
  • Conhecimento em Docker e Kubernetes , incluindo deploy, escalabilidade e operação de aplicações conteinerizadas;
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Vivência com observabilidade (Datadog, Grafana, Kibana);
  • Experiência com CI/CD e práticas modernas de engenharia de software;
  • Noções ou experiência em Ciência de Dados;
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de busca em e-commerce;
  • Vivência com experimentação , métricas e testes A/B para validação de hipóteses e comprovação de conceitos.


O que esperamos do seu perfil

  • Mentalidade de dono , com visão sistêmica e foco em longo prazo;
  • Capacidade de influenciar tecnicamente e elevar a barra do time;
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e assertiva , inclusive com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Perfil colaborativo , pragmático e orientado a resultados.

title: Assistente Juridico Administrativo
description:
Estamos em busca de um Assistente Juridico Administrativo para fazer parte do time da Fevereiro & Cruz Marcas e Patentes, um escritório de 13 anos de idade na cidade de São Paulo e agora está iniciando a sua jornada na cidade de Campinas. Nosso maior propósito é gerar e agregar valor para as empresas através dos seus ativos marcas e patentes, com experiência de serviço, a fim de ficarmos marcados em suas memórias pela qualidade do nosso trabalho.

Principais responsabilidades da função:

• Abertura e cadastro de casos novos;

• Solicitação de cadastramento de clientes/documentos;

• Acompanhamento dos prazos administrativos;

• Gestão de ferramentas jurídicas;

• Preenchimento de formulários;

• Geração de guias e petições eletrônicas;

• Elaboração de peças administrativas e seu protocolamento;

• Análise de contratos;

• Apoio à elaboração de documentos legais. Auxilia na redação e organização de petições, contratos, relatórios, pareceres e outros documentos jurídicos.

• Realiza pesquisas em legislações, jurisprudências, doutrinas e outros documentos legais para fornecer informações atualizadas e embasar argumentos e defesas.

• Envio de e-mails periódicos;

• Elaboração de relatórios/pareceres para clientes;

• Atendimento a clientes.

Execução de outras atividades correlatas à função, que possam surgir no decorrer das operações, demonstrando flexibilidade e adaptabilidade para lidar com diversas demandas.


Requisitos:

• Bacharel em Direito ou cursando a partir do 4º semestre;

• Experiência com sistemas de gestão jurídica

• Capacidade de lidar com situações de estresse e pressão, especialmente ao lidar diretamente com os clientes.

• Demonstração de responsabilidade extrema no cumprimento das tarefas atribuídas.

• Proficiência excepcional na língua portuguesa, tanto na comunicação verbal quanto na escrita.

• Proatividade para antecipar necessidades e resolver problemas de forma eficiente.

• Habilidade organizacional para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e garantir a eficiência operacional.


Será considerado um diferencial ter experiência prévia no ramo da propriedade industrial.


Modelo de trabalho: presencial Disponibilidade de tempo: Horário: Segunda à sexta-feira, das 08:30h às 18:00h Contratação: CLT. Remuneração: R$2.500,00. Benefícios: Vale alimentação/refeição + vale transporte.

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Desenvolvedor(a) Back End Java/Kotlin - SR, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Habilidades Principais:

  • Forte experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Java e Kotlin , atuando em aplicações escaláveis e distribuídas.
  • Vivência prática em AWS , utilizando serviços como ECS, EC2, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFront, Load Balancer, Auto Scaling e CloudFormation.
  • Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento , especialmente com Datadog , além de atuação com testes unitários, de performance e E2E .
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Git/GitHub , práticas DevOps e pipelines de CI/CD .
  • Diferenciais: uso de Terraform para infraestrutura como código e Python para automação de tarefas.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS) - HOME OFFICE
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.


You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Líder de Fábrica de Software SAP ABAP e BW
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Líder de Fábrica de Software SAP ABAP e BW


Remoto - Brasil.

Horário - Comercial.


Procuramos profissional experiente para conduzir e desenvolver equipes SAP ABAP e BW. Profissional focado em liderança técnica, governança de entregas e capacitação de times, que será o ponto focal de sustentação e projetos.

title: Risk Control Specialist (Evening shift)
description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Conduct user audits on the company's risk control platform
  • Monitor for and promptly respond to any abnormal transaction data, making judgments as necessary
  • Continually learn about the platform's rules and enhance personal and professional skills
  • Keep abreast of external competitors' changes in risk control rules and provide suggestions based on current regulations


Requirements

  • At least 1 year of working experience in risk control/transaction monitoring/customer support
  • Possess business sensitivity and awareness of risk
  • Strong psychological quality with effective communication and judgment skills
  • Strong logical thinking and data collection and analysis abilities
  • Strict adherence to professional ethics and information security and confidentiality in daily work
  • Work Schedule: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM (Brazil Time)


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

Job Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled and creative Graphic Designer with strong video editing capabilities and a solid, well-rounded portfolio. title: Desenvolvimento Kotlin, Java, Python AWS - 123816
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior


Requisitos:

Kotlin, com ênfase em Java Spring Boot, Python e AWS. Requisitos Técnicos: Kotlin (Habilidade Principal). Experiência com Kotlin para desenvolvimento backend. Conhecimento em frameworks como Ktor ou Spring Boot com Kotlin. Boas práticas de programação funcional e orientada a objetos em Kotlin. - Uso de coroutines para programação assíncrona. - Testes automatizados com JUnit, MockK ou Kotest. Java + Spring Boot. Experiência com Spring Boot e seus módulos (Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud). - Uso de JPA/Hibernate para persistência de dados. - Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e GraphQL. - Testes com JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers. Python. Conhecimento básico ou intermediário para **scripts, automação e integração**. - Experiência com frameworks como **FastAPI ou Flask** é um diferencial. - Manipulação de dados com **Pandas e NumPy** (caso necessário). **AWS (Cloud)** - Experiência com **AWS Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, API Gateway e IAM**. - Infraestrutura como código (**Terraform, AWS CDK ou CloudFormation**). - Monitoramento e logging com **CloudWatch**. - Conhecimento em **ECS, EKS ou Kubernetes** é um diferencial. **Outros Conhecimentos Desejáveis** - Experiência com **CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)**. - Banco de dados **SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)**. - Mensageria com **Kafka ou RabbitMQ**. - Containers e Docker. - Arquitetura de microsserviços e eventos. Principais Responsabilidades do Desenvolvedor 1. Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento Backend Criar e manter microsserviços escaláveis usando Kotlin (Spring Boot). Projetar e desenvolver APIs REST e GraphQL. Implementar boas práticas de clean code, design patterns e SOLID. Gerenciar persistência de dados utilizando PostgreSQL, DynamoDB ou MongoDB. 2. Integração com AWS e Infraestrutura Desenvolver e otimizar soluções utilizando AWS Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, API Gateway e RDS. Criar pipelines de infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou AWS CDK). Implementar monitoramento e logging com AWS CloudWatch e Prometheus. 3. Processamento e Automação de Dados Construir pipelines de processamento de dados com Kafka ou AWS Kinesis. Criar automações e scripts auxiliares em Python para análise de dados, ETL ou machine learning. 4. Segurança e Performance Implementar OAuth2, JWT ou AWS Cognito para autenticação e autorização. Monitorar performance e escalabilidade, otimizando queries e serviços. 5. DevOps e CI/CD Automatizar deploys utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/Fargate ou EKS. Configurar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 6. Colaboração e Melhoria Contínua Trabalhar em equipe, revisando códigos (Code Review) e propondo melhorias. Manter documentação técnica clara e atualizada. Participar de decisões arquiteturais e estratégias de evolução do sistema.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
  • Conhecimento em Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) será considerado um diferencial, especialmente para gerenciar contratos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida, da criação à renovação e fechamento;


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL
description:
Title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.


Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.


We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.


What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.


As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.


The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.


This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.


Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.


The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.


You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.



What You'll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency


Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow \"show-don't-tell\" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale


Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency


You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



You're a Great Fit If...

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention


You'll thrive if you:

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
  • Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
  • Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)



What We Offer

Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency



How to Apply

Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered:


When submitting you'll be asked to include:

  • Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  • A short note and example marketing asset (3-4 sentences): Show us one marketing asset you're proud of and tell us why it worked.


We're excited to meet you!

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market.   • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention


You'll thrive if you:

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
  • Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
  • Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)



What We Offer

Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency



How to Apply

Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered:


When submitting you'll be asked to include:

  • Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  • A short note and example marketing asset (3-4 sentences): Show us one marketing asset you're proud of and tell us why it worked.


We're excited to meet you!

title: Desenvolvedor Java Back-end
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end Java para atuar em um ambiente de alta criticidade , com foco em integrações, mensageria e microsserviços , participando ativamente do desenvolvimento de soluções robustas e escaláveis.


Stack Tecnológico

Obrigatório:

  • Java 11+;
  • Spring Boot;
  • APIs REST;
  • RabbitMQ;
  • MongoDB;
  • Oracle.

Desejável:

  • Kafka;
  • Redis;
  • Docker;
  • Kubernetes / OpenShift;
  • Observabilidade (Datadog, AppDynamics, ELK).

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Criar e consumir filas RabbitMQ (listeners para eventos de renovação e cancelamento).
  • Implementar integrações REST com sistemas como BCP, Bureau, Dossiê, Sinistro e Vistoria Prévia.
  • Desenvolver endpoints para geração de ofertas APA / AFI.
  • Realizar manutenção e ajustes em tabelas Oracle.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de Clean Code, SOLID e Design Patterns.
  • Participar de code reviews e pair programming.
  • Garantir cobertura de testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito).

Requisitos Técnicos

Obrigatórios:

  • 3+ anos de experiência com Java e Spring Boot em produção.
  • Experiência sólida com microsserviços e APIs REST.
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (RabbitMQ ou Kafka).
  • Domínio de bancos relacionais (Oracle/PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB).
  • Versionamento de código com Git / GitLab.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Kubernetes / OpenShift.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento.
  • Certificação Oracle Certified Professional.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

title: TIBCO EBX Developer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Java development, ideally applied within TIBCO EBX extensions or customizations;
  • Hands‑on experience developing on TIBCO EBX (data modeling, workflows, services, UI configuration, data quality rules);
  • Understanding of Master Data Management (MDM) processes and governance, especially in EBX contexts;
  • Strong understanding of Java design patterns, MVC, and Java data structures, supporting EBX development best practices;
  • English B2 and Portuguese native;
  • Must relocate to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: relocation to Portugal and in here will be 2x on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send apply!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: IT Project & Implementation Specialist
description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro


Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar como especialista em Serviços Profissionais na Lynx Financial Crime Tech, com uma posição baseada no Brasil, em modelo remoto, em colaboração com o time global de Serviços Profissionais em Madrid (Espanha) e com foco em clientes no Brasil e em outros países da América Latina.


A Lynx Financial Crime Tech S.A, é uma empresa de software baseado em IA, especializada em detectar e prever padrões de comportamento. Liderados por uma equipe experiente do setor financeiro e acadêmico, desenvolvemos e implementamos tecnologias de IA de ponta e autoaprendizado. Nossa plataforma se destaca em tecnologias de processamento de transações de baixa latência e está disponível tanto on-premise quanto em nuvem.

Priorizamos VISÃO, AGILIDADE e VELOCIDADE para oferecer experiências excepcionais aos clientes e construímos relacionamentos duradouros e de confiança com algumas das principais instituições financeiras, fintechs e empresas comerciais em todo o mundo.

Adotamos uma forte cultura de risco e esperamos que toda a nossa equipe, independentemente do cargo que ocupem, tenha uma atitude proativa e responsável em relação à gestão de riscos. A Lynx se orgulha de ser uma organização com igualdade de oportunidades, independentemente de identidade de gênero, cultura ou deficiência. Nossa missão é contribuir para que mais pessoas e empresas prosperem.


O que você vai fazer

Como IT Project & Implementation Specialist, seu objetivo será garantir um serviço excelente para nossos clientes sediados no Brasil (e em outras regiões da América Latina), participando ativamente das diferentes etapas do ciclo de vida: onboarding, implantação, acompanhamento e novas necessidades.

Precisamos de alguém como você para nos ajudar em diferentes frentes:

· Liderar e gerir projetos de implementação das nossas soluções.

· Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes: identificar novas necessidades, resolver dúvidas e oferecer orientação sobre o uso correto das nossas soluções.

· Fornecer consultoria especializada e executar os serviços profissionais das nossas soluções de Detecção e Prevenção de Crime Financeiro e Lavagem de Dinheiro.

· Dar suporte técnico aos nossos times internos de Vendas nas fases iniciais de contato com clientes: demos, reuniões técnicas etc.

· Atuar como elo entre nossos clientes e as equipes de Desenvolvimento e Suporte.


✅ O que buscamos em você

Experiência em gestão de projetos de tecnologia;

Ensino superior completo;

Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras ou empresas relacionadas ao setor;

Experiência em departamentos de Serviços Profissionais em outras empresas do setor;

Idiomas: domínio avançado de inglês (mandatório).


✅ O que pode contar pontos a mais

Conhecimentos de Linux – nível usuário.

Espanhol avançado;

Conhecimento em Fraude e/ou Lavagem de Dinheiro;

Capacidade para trabalhar em equipe;

Boas habilidades de comunicação;

Capacidade de se adaptar a ambientes em constante mudança.


Seguinte passo

Candidate-se e se você conhece alguém que possa estar procurando por essa oportunidade, compartilhe.

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience solving complex technical problems across front-end, back-end, and full-stack technologies, including Angular, to join our U.S. client. The ideal candidate should have experience in server-side logic development, defining and maintaining central databases, and ensuring high performance and request responsiveness. The role will involve transforming UI / UX designs into functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (including Angular). The primary application stack is LAMP, comprising the latest versions of PHP, MySQL, and Linux, along with Angular for front-end development. You will also be responsible for integrating Angular components built by co-workers into the application.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Build efficient, testable, and reusable PHP or JavaScript modules
  • Identify solutions to complex problems
  • Solve performance issues and architectural challenges
  • Integrate data storage solutions like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Ensure that the code that you produce passes the SonarCloud quality rules for each pull request
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by front-end developers, including Angular components
  • Translate UI / UX designs and convert them into working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including Angular
  • Analyze, configure, and tune the front-end web application, including Angular performance optimization
  • Be a subject matter expert on web technologies, including Angular
  • Enforce software development standards and mentor junior engineers in Angular development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in web application development using Angular
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks and libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symphony, and Doctrine)
  • Understanding of MVC design patterns, front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Angular), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design principles (including Angular architecture and scalability considerations), and user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with code review and analysis tools, such as SonarCloud
  • Experience with AWS
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Consultor(a) de Comunicação Interna (Eventos e Comunidade)
description:
A Screencorp é especialista em soluções de Comunicação Interna para aproximar empresas e colaboradores.


Nossa missão é ajudar empresas a se comunicarem melhor com seus colaboradores, fornecendo tecnologia relevante e contextualizada com o objetivo de aumentar engajamento e estabelecer um propósito compartilhado de trabalho.

O Desafio

Você será a \"cara\" da Screencorp para o mercado e para nossa base de clientes.

Seu papel é híbrido: você atuará na educação do mercado através de eventos, no fortalecimento da nossa rede de contatos em RH e na identificação de oportunidades estratégicas dentro dos clientes que já confiam na nossa marca.


Suas Principais Missões:
  • Gestão de Experiências: Planejar e executar o calendário de eventos (webinars, meetups remotos e eventos presenciais de networking) focados em tendências de CI e RH.
  • Fortalecimento de Comunidade: Atuar ativamente em grupos, associações e comunidades de RH/Comunicação para posicionar a Screencorp como autoridade no setor.
  • Faro de Negócios (Growth na Base): Atuar consultivamente com nossos clientes atuais para entender suas dores e identificar momentos ideais para ofertas de upsell (upgrade de plano) ou cross-sell (adoção de novos produtos do ecossistema Screencorp).
  • Embaixador(a) da Marca: Representar a empresa em feiras, congressos e entrevistas para a mídia, disseminando nossa cultura e visão sobre o futuro do trabalho.
  • Produção de Conteúdo Estratégico: Apoiar o time de marketing com insights vindos diretamente da comunidade para a criação de materiais que ajudem na conversão.

    • O que buscamos:
    • Formação em Comunicação Social, Relações Públicas, Jornalismo ou Marketing.
    • Experiência prévia com Organização de Eventos (do planejamento à execução).
    • Perfil \"Hunter\" de Relacionamento: alguém que sinta facilidade em abordar pessoas e construir pontes (Networking).
    • Visão de Negócios: entender que a comunicação deve estar alinhada aos KPIs de vendas e retenção.
    • Excelente oratória e desenvoltura para falar em público e em vídeos.
    • Desejável: Conhecimento prévio do mercado de SaaS ou vivência em RH/Endomarketing.


    Soft Skills que valorizamos:
    • Atitude de Dono: você encara cada evento como um projeto pessoal, agindo com autonomia e proatividade para superar as expectativas.
    • Escuta Ativa: essencial para identificar oportunidades de vendas de forma consultiva e natural.
    • Resiliência: para lidar com a dinâmica de eventos e negociações.
    O que oferecemos:
    • 100% Home Office (não iremos voltar ao presencial)
    • Ambiente respeitoso, informal e pragmático
    • Auxílio Home office
    • Flash Benefícios
    • Plano de saúde Sulamérica
    • Folga no aniversário
    • Enviamos os equipamentos eletrônicos necessários para seu trabalho
    • Contratação CLT

title: Customer Success Consultant
description:
Customer Success & Business Development Consultant – Latin America

CAS uses intuitive technology, unparalleled scientific content, and unmatched human expertise to help companies create groundbreaking innovations that benefit the world. As the scientific information solutions division of the American Chemical Society, CAS manages the largest curated reservoir of scientific knowledge and, for over 115 years, has helped innovators mine, assess, and apply that information to keep businesses thriving. The CAS team is global, diverse, endlessly curious, and strives to make scientific insights accessible to innovators worldwide.


CAS is seeking an independent consultant to support delivering services that combine customer success expertise with business development activities, focusing on consultative engagement, solution-oriented selling, and collaborative account management.


Key Deliveries include:

Customer Success & Engagement

  • Facilitate onboarding and enablement sessions for CAS users.
  • Provide guidance to help customers realize the full value of CAS solutions.
  • Maintain strong relationships across multiple levels within client organizations.

Business Development

  • Identify opportunities to grow, retain, and cross-sell within existing accounts.
  • Develop a pipeline of new business opportunities in the assigned territory.
  • Conduct prospecting activities, including calls, emails, and presentations.

Strategic Communication

  • Deliver compelling presentations and messaging to build awareness of CAS solutions.
  • Support marketing activities such as workshops, seminars, and industry events.
  • Represent CAS at conferences and trade shows as agreed.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate records of activities and opportunities in CRM (Salesforce/LEX).
  • Provide regular progress updates on engagement metrics and deliverables.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a science-related field (preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sales, account management, customer success, and business development.
  • English fluency (written and spoken); Portuguese required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce/LEX) and virtual meeting tools (Teams, Zoom, WebEx).
  • Dynamic, proactive, and collaborative mindset.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).


Required Expertise:

  • Proven success in solution-based sales and consultative engagement.
  • Strong ability to translate complex concepts into clear, actionable insights.
  • Skilled in relationship building across organizational levels.
  • Familiarity with scientific information tools and intellectual property solutions (preferred).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


Location & Travel

Based in Brazil; with regional travel within Brazil and across Latin America required up to 20% of the time.


This is an independent consulting engagement. The consultant will be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business expenses. Duration, deliverables, and compensation will be agreed upon in the consulting contract.


To apply for this consulting position, please submit your cover letter and CV to

title: JD Edwards (Financial Consultant)
description:
Business Analyst (Financial)


**Add resumes in English**


• Ensure JDE, Trintech, and other financial applications are compliant with Gallagher’s IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.

• Evaluate SOC reports to ensure vendor and application compliance and surface risks.

Skills

Required:

• Relevant experience working with Financial ERP applications, preferably JDE

• Design and Development Experience with JDE

• Experience working with third party vendors to implement SaaS solutions

• Working \"hands-on\" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of key accounting, financial management and analysis processes, including but not limited to General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, revenue recognition, budgeting, and bank interfaces

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel and Project


Requirements:


• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

• Relevant experience with technology project support

• Experience with one or for of the following applications: JDE, Trintech Cadency, Workiva, Cognos Analytics, Analytics, OneStream, and Varicent

• Understanding of Single Sign-On and Identity Management solutions

• Advanced level proficiency with Microsoft Office tools including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio

• Intermediate SQL query skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams

title: Mobile III (PLENO)
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Sr. Procurement Analyst -80% Spanish
description:
About the Job


Sr. Procurement Analyst will execute and manage Indirect spend categories' strategic sourcing and procurement across all supply chain operations facility types agreed to be in-scope and will deliver business requirements providing the best value to key business stakeholders.The focus will be managing the end-to-end strategic sourcing process and all in-scope elements of indirect spend for LATAM with emphasis on Brazil and the rest of the countries of South America (not limited).


Scope: Regions: Americas (subregion: LATAM)


Languages : Portuguese and Spanish 90%


Key Responsibilities May Include:


  • Develop and execute category strategies aligned with regional and global procurement priorities, leveraging market analysis to optimize supplier selection and performance.
  • Lead end-to-end sourcing activities, including negotiating contracts, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities within assigned categories to meet annual savings targets and drive value for the business.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to align procurement activities with business needs and ensure early involvement in the sourcing process.
  • Monitor supplier performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) and address gaps to improve quality, delivery, and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure procurement activities adhere to governance, ethical sourcing practices, and sustainability objectives while supporting audit and compliance requirements.
  • Provide regular reporting and analytics on procurement performance, including spend analysis, cost savings, and supplier performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with global category managers and cross-functional teams to leverage scale, align strategies, and drive procurement initiatives effectively.



Experience- What you will bring


  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred (Business, Supply Chain, or Engineering).
  • Operations support experience.
  • 4+ years of procurement experience supporting business operations with YoY savings.
  • Strong supplier segmentation, supplier performance and relationship management
  • experience
  • Experience in business operations, or supporting operations, at a large
  • multinational company.
  • Strategic Sourcing knowledge and experience (7-Step Process).
  • Procurement/Purchasing Experience +5 years
  • Contract negotiations.
  • Customer service minded.



Skills & Knowledge

Strong Negotiation and commercial contracting skills specially in professional services,

facilities and maintenance (MRO).

• Use of computer tools such as Microsoft Excel, Coupa, CLMs.

• Knowledge of plant operations preferred.

• This role demands continuous interaction with key stakeholders within Brambles Supply

Chain and Corporate Business.

• Data Analytics (Intermediate level Excel to include Pivot tables, formulas, etc.) with

development potential.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno (Fiscal)
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.



Principais Responsabilidades:


- Análise, design e codificação de aplicativos voltados para entrega de obrigações fiscais, tais como: NF-e, CT-e, NFS-e, MDF-e, Reinf, etc.

- Participação ativa no ciclo de desenvolvimento, trabalhando com dinâmicas ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, inclusive com interfaces em times com diferentes tecnologias.

- Atuar integrado ao time, mantendo a aplicação como full-cycle, sendo responsável desde o desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades a resolução de problemas em ambientes produtivos.

- Colaboração ativa com stakeholders internos e externos.

- Atuar com foco nos clientes para entender os requisitos do negócio e buscar liberações de valor.

- Participação ativa na manutenção das práticas, padrões e processos que permeiam os padrões de desenvolvimento e qualidade.

- Ser referência no apoio técnico aos recursos de menos senioridade, sempre validando os padrões com a gestão.




Requisitos Necessários:


- Ensino superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlacionadas.

- Experiência comprovada de 5 anos ou mais no desenvolvimento de aplicações em Java 11 (ou superior);

- Certificações em JAVA são considerados diferenciais;

- Experiencia em Jasper é considerado diferencial;

- Experiência com Integração de sistemas (SOAP, REST);

- Experiência com SQL (JDBC);

- Experiência com Git;

- Familiaridade com frameworks e métodos ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban.

- Boa comunicação, capacidade de trabalho em equipe e habilidades de resolução de problemas;

- Desejável conhecimento de ferramentas da Atlassian (Jira, Bitbucket, Confluence);

- Inglês Avançado (diferencial);


CLT
